messages:
sarah: FYI incoming pen-test intake from partner set for 2026-02-20. Need three things: RBAC freeze window, KMS access policy (no decrypt), and artifact handoff method. Who can take the evidence packaging?

matt: Dates? scope?

sarah: 2026-02-20 08:00 -> 2026-02-21 18:00 UTC. Scope = staging + perf-integration cluster. No prod. Includes S3 reads, auth flows, runtime KMS sign/verify.

devops: We'll not give decrypt. Plan: KMS proxy that supports `sign` and `verify` only. Assessors get sealed ciphertext objects and presigned GETs. If they request crypto ops, route through proxy with full observability.

sec-oncall: I can stand up ephemeral roles. Proposed TTL 4h, OKTA mapping assessor email -> principal. Command: `./grant-temp --principal assessor:partner --scope staging:read,kms-proxy:sign --ttl 4h`.

matt: Evidence format suggestion: gzip tarball `evidence-<partner>-YYYYMMDD.tar.gz` with folders: `audit/`, `configs/`, `objects/`, and `manifest.csv`. Manifest columns: path, sha256, size, type, owner, export_tool_version, timestamp.

sarah: Add `gpg_sig` file too. Sign the manifest with our offline key and include fingerprint in top-level metadata.

devops: KMS proxy log fields we'll capture: ts, request_id, principal, operation, key_alias, payload_hash, response_code, authorization_hint, trace_id. Will include requester IP if available.

matt: For retest gating: P0/P1 = block until fixed & verified; P2 = mitigation + test plan; P3/P4 = schedule. We'll publish a triage sheet with owners before the window.

sarah: RBAC freeze: restrict IAM edits in staging during the engagement day (00:00-23:59 UTC). Exception process: `./request-rbac-exception --ticket <URL>` requiring dual approval from sec-oncall + infra lead.

sec-oncall: Retention: keep handoff artifacts for 120 days. S3 escrow path will be `s3://pt-escrow/partner-20260220/`. I'll create presigned GET valid 7 days and post link here when ready.

devops: I'll run a dry-run tomorrow 09:00 UTC to validate proxy logging, presigned URL upload, and manifest signing. Everyone invited.

matt: I'll produce a sample tar + manifest and upload to `s3://pt-escrow/partner-20260220/sample/` by EOD. Example jq for sampling: `jq -c '.Records[] | select(.eventName=="GetObject")' cloudtrail.json > objects/s3-get.ndjson`

sarah: Good. Owners: sarah -> overall coord + triage; devops -> proxy + presigned path; matt -> packaging + manifest; sec-oncall -> RBAC freeze enforcement + runbook. engsec-bot: create calendar?

engsec-bot: calendar event created: "Partner Pen Test - Staging" 2026-02-20 08:00 -> 2026-02-21 18:00 UTC. Reminder set.

sarah: Thanks team. Dry-run tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Please post runbook links and presigned URL when available. :thumbsup:
